author: Wanda Wilson Dooley
text: Did you wash your skin with soap and water and let it completely dry then, wipe it with an alcohol wipe or a cotton ball soaked in alcohol and wait 20 to 30 seconds to make sure that is completely dry before applying the sensor?

author: Kim Smith
text: I live in FNQ very humid and hot. I only use a Type Strong clear patch and never had one fall off.
